sentences: 1) The terminal starts timer T901 when a SessionRequest message is sent.
2) The terminal stops timer T901 when a SessionAccept message is received, and stores the received parameters.
3) The terminal applies SessionUpdate parameters in the order received.
4) The terminal answers each SessionUpdate message with a SessionUpdateComplete message.
5) The terminal must not release the session before it has answered.
6) The list above is not exhaustive.

requirements.text: The terminal shall start timer T901 when a SessionRequest message is sent.
The terminal shall stop timer T901 when a SessionAccept message is received.
The terminal shall store the received parameters when a SessionAccept message is received.
The terminal shall apply SessionUpdate parameters in the order received.
The terminal shall answer each SessionUpdate message with a SessionUpdateComplete message.
The terminal shall not release the session before it has answered.
